changeSet.comment: nexus.quarantine_restore_chunks restores a chunk with metadata holding only the CHUNK keys of the key table (chunk_text_hash, embedding_model, derived from the chash and embedding_model columns) and judges the reattach plan from the quarantine copy before the move, so a restore with reattach still attaches in the same call while no document key returns to the live collection; a restore with reattach off marks the verdict row of a chunk whose forward owner link it drops with reason owner_link_dropped (nexus-l003p, RDR-236 Phase 4). A chunk the plan refuses as rival, or because its owner is mid index run or failed its last run, is not moved: it stays in quarantine with its keys (r_outcome kept), so the refusal holds across pages, calls, siblings and a busy retry and a rerun after the run finishes still attaches it. The audit row records the dropped owner links and the kept chunks. One CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION, signature and grants kept. No data effect.
